prerequisites: Basic knowledge of general laws of rigid solid mechanics and their application to engineering problems.

learning_outcomes.text: Identify and quantify different types of forces, stresses, and deformations.
Dimension and check simple mechanical elements.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts about Elasticity. Failure criteria
Simple stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams.
Combined stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams.

assessment_methods.method: Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation, Ordinary Call)
Continuous Evaluation score (PLs and Controls) (Continuous Evaluation, Ordinary Call)
Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation, Extraordinary Calls)
Half of Continuous Evaluation score (PLs, Controls) (Continuous Evaluation, Extraordinary Calls)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Evaluation in Ordinary Call, the final grade is 80% from the written exam and 20% from continuous evaluation (PLs and 2 short controls). For Extraordinary Calls under Continuous Evaluation, the final grade is 90% from the written exam and 10% from half of the continuous evaluation score obtained previously. Differentiated Evaluation consists of a 100% written theoretical-practical exam.
